Hi Samantha / OEM team,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Nimbus has signaled the 50-GPU committed pool as part of D-77821; to finalize our onboarding sprint we need a short, machine-readable ETA cadence from your side and a clear confirmation on the unit SKU set (A100 vs A800 variants).

Can you do two quick things this week:
- Share a row-level ETA table (units, SKU, ship week, lead time assumptions) — CSV or XLSX is ideal.
- Flag any single points of failure (custom brackets, thermal fixtures, customs constraints) that could add >2 weeks to delivery.

We'll propose a sprint calendar that includes a cloud-backstop arrangement with CloudBridge for the first 6 weeks. Cc'ing Karthik and Laura to scope the cloud fallback and the onboarding window.

Thanks,

Hi Jonas / Samantha,

Thanks for the note. Please see the attached ETA table — this is our preliminary lane based on current factory slots and freight windows. Key caveats:
- SKU mix: A800 availability is constrained in May; we can supply up to 30 A800s and the balance as A800-LT (2–3% perf variance).
- Customs & port: East Coast ports currently have a 7–12 day variance; we recommend sourcing a 10% buffer if you require a firm onboarding date.
- Thermal kits: Special-order brackets add ~10 business days.

We'll follow up with a firm booking ETA once Nimbus confirms exact SKU counts.

Best,
OEM Logistics Ops Team

Quick internal / cross-team note — I ran two options with CloudBridge for the 6-week backstop:
- Option A (hot): 50 pre-provisioned slots, ~20% premium on monthly committed rate, immediate availability next week. Requires short-term credit hold and L2 network peering prep.
- Option B (warm): 50 elastic slots, lower cost but 48–72 hour warmup for KV cache priming; good if we can accept up to 2 days of tail latency variance during the first onboarding week.

If Nimbus confirms 40 A800 / 10 A100 and OEM can guarantee 30 A800 in week 3, I recommend Option A for the first 3 weeks switching to Option B as OEM shipments land — reduces customer risk and preserves the onboarding SLO.

Action items for sales/ops:
1) Ben to confirm deposit cadence with Nimbus legal.
2) Laura to publish a sprint calendar that marks firm vs speculative weeks and ties to invoice milestones.

-Karthik
Head of Dedicated Solutions
